info.name: Tream API — M01–M04
info.description: Implemented NestJS APIs only. Import the accompanying local environment and run ONLY the 01 Smoke folder for an automatic end-to-end run. Other folders are manual recipes with stateful prerequisites. All requests disable the cookie jar and use non-browser explicit refresh-token mode; no Origin header. Authentication tokens are stored only in the selected environment. SMTP/mailbox tokens must be supplied manually. See README.md.

item.name: 01 Smoke — run this folder
item.description: Automatic smoke run. Creates two accounts, a workspace, an invitation and encrypted mail jobs. Tests idempotency/RBAC and restores the workspace after lifecycle tests. Requires migrated API and PostgreSQL; does not require reading email.

request.description: Generates unique test identities and slug on every smoke run. Sends no Origin and uses explicit refresh-token mode.
